++++++++The Hello Kitty: A Springfield Armory Hellcat(and Pro) Frame by DB Firearms++++++++


These frames are designed to turn your Springfield Hellcat and Hellcat Pro parts kits back into functional firearms. YAY!
These are not designed to be a 1:1 representation of the OEM hellcat aesthetically(more of a homage). However, these are functional frames. The main frame was edited from the "poorcat" by InsertMeow. Special thanks to IMA for the base for this frame.


There are 3 styles of frames in the files.
Hellcat: Original hellcat frame  for the compact mags (13rd or 11rd)
Hellcat X: For OG hellcat parts kits, but using the "Pro" 17rd magazines (Short slide long mag)
Hellcat Pro: For Pro kits, with longer slides. Only compatible with Pro mags which are 17rds.
